patch_description: Revert to the higher-scoring modular block design (RY -> ring CRZ -> RX -> skip-2 CRZ -> skip-3 CRZ -> diameter CRZ) that previously achieved test_accuracy 0.90 / score 0.89, replacing the current simpler block (which regressed to 0.87). Additionally extend from two stacked copies to three stacked copies of the same shared-parameter block, testing whether extra shared depth (without increasing parameter count) yields further accuracy gains, per the recommendation. Parameter count stays fixed since all copies reuse identical parameter names; only depth/gate-count increase, which should improve expressivity while the strong parameter sharing continues to act as an implicit regularizer, keeping the train-validation gap controlled.
